title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #2 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a good habit for cleaning after using the toilet? (1 mark)
   A. Use nothing
   B. Skip washing
   C. Use water and wash hands with soap
   D. Leave it

2. How many types of najasaat are taught in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Two
   C. Five
   D. Three

3. If wudhu breaks during prayer, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Continue
   B. Ignore it
   C. Pray louder
   D. Stop, make wudhu and start the prayer again

4. Which of these shows waste in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving the tap running
   B. Closing the tap
   C. Using a small jug
   D. Saving water

5. Why do Muslims all over the world face the same direction? (1 mark)
   A. By accident
   B. It unites us
   C. For sport
   D. To confuse others

6. Which of these can help find the Qibla? (1 mark)
   A. The noise from the road
   B. The colour of the sky
   C. A compass or Qibla app
   D. The size of the mosque

7. Which is a condition of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Prostrating
   B. Facing the Qibla
   C. Taslim
   D. Bowing

8. What is a mihrab? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer time
   B. A type of clothes
   C. The niche in a mosque showing the Qibla
   D. A cap

9. What is a condition of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Something needed before the prayer starts
   B. A part inside prayer
   C. A festival
   D. A type of dua

10. What did the Prophet tell the man who prayed in a hurry? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore it
   B. Continue
   C. Pray faster
   D. Go back and pray again

11. What do we say in ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
   B. Bismillah
   C. Alhamdulillah
   D. Subhana Rabbiyal Azim

12. What is the tashahhud? (1 mark)
   A. The recitation in sitting that includes the testimony of faith
   B. The call to prayer
   C. The niyyah
   D. A bowing

13. Why should we not pollute rivers? (1 mark)
   A. Rivers are ugly
   B. Only people use rivers
   C. Fish do not matter
   D. Fish and other creatures live there

14. Which animal do people in northern Kenya commonly use to carry loads? (1 mark)
   A. Monkey
   B. Camel
   C. Hippo
   D. Zebra

15. A girl wants to play football modestly. Which outfit suits? (1 mark)
   A. Tracksuit with long trousers and sports headscarf
   B. A very tight top
   C. A torn shirt
   D. A see-through top

16. Which statement about dress is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Rules are only for adults
   B. Boys also have rules of modesty
   C. Nobody has rules
   D. Only girls have rules

17. What did the Prophet say about speech? (1 mark)
   A. Say everything
   B. Say whatever
   C. Say what is good or keep silent
   D. Speak loudly

18. What is a good media rule? (1 mark)
   A. Ask parents before using devices
   B. Share passwords
   C. Download any app
   D. Use a phone secretly

19. Which is a life skill related to this topic? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Wasting money
   C. Gambling
   D. Avoiding begging without justification

20. Which is a way a child can earn safely with permission? (1 mark)
   A. Doing chores for a small reward
   B. Taking loans
   C. Begging on the road
   D. Stealing

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Describe how to find the Qibla using the sun in Kenya. (3 marks)

22. Explain tuma'ninah and give the story that shows its importance. (3 marks)

23. Define wudhu and state its intention. (2 marks)

24. State two reasons why we wear clothes. (2 marks)

25. State three things that nullify wudhu. (3 marks)

26. State four features of the Islamic code of dressing. (4 marks)

27. Why do Muslims all over the world face the Qibla? (4 marks)

28. Describe how a class can show kindness to creatures in the school compound. (4 marks)

29. Write the pillars of swalah from ruku up to taslim. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Use water and wash hands with soap
   Water is best.

2. D — Three
   Light, medium and heavy.

3. D — Stop, make wudhu and start the prayer again
   Prayer needs valid wudhu.

4. A — Leaving the tap running
   Islam teaches us not to waste water.

5. B — It unites us
   The Qibla unites Muslims.

6. C — A compass or Qibla app
   A compass helps find north.

7. B — Facing the Qibla
   Facing Qibla is a condition; bowing is a pillar.

8. C — The niche in a mosque showing the Qibla
   It marks the direction of prayer.

9. A — Something needed before the prayer starts
   Conditions come before the prayer begins.

10. D — Go back and pray again
   He did not pray properly.

11. D — Subhana Rabbiyal Azim
   Glory to my Lord, the Most Great.

12. A — The recitation in sitting that includes the testimony of faith
   It is recited in sitting.

13. D — Fish and other creatures live there
   Pollution harms creatures.

14. B — Camel
   Camels carry loads in dry areas.

15. A — Tracksuit with long trousers and sports headscarf
   It allows free movement and modesty.

16. B — Boys also have rules of modesty
   Both boys and girls dress modestly.

17. C — Say what is good or keep silent
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

18. A — Ask parents before using devices
   Permission keeps children safe.

19. D — Avoiding begging without justification
   Self-awareness.

20. A — Doing chores for a small reward
   With parents' permission.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stretch the right arm towards the sunrise, which is east, and face forward, which is roughly north. Confirm with a compass or mosque.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the right arm to east, 1 mark for facing north, 1 mark for checking.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tuma'ninah is staying still and calm in each position. The Prophet told a man who prayed hurriedly to go back and pray again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for the story, 1 mark for the lesson.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wudhu is washing certain parts of the body with water to prepare for prayer. The intention is made in the heart.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for definition and 1 mark for intention.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: To cover the body, to protect us from weather, and to look neat and dignified.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Urine, stool or wind; deep sleep lying down; fainting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Cover the awrah, loose and not see-through, clean and neat, not for showing off, no rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah commanded it in the Qur'an (2:144). It unites Muslims and shows that we worship one Lord.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for command, 1 mark for the verse or Kaaba, 1 mark for unity, 1 mark for one Lord.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant and water trees, put out water for birds, keep the compound clean, do not harm insects and animals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid action.

29. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ruku, rising from ruku, sujud, sitting between the sujud, last sitting, tashahhud, blessings on the Prophet, taslim.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for each two correct pillars up to 4 and 1 mark for correct order.
